name: TAL_PROXIMAL
comments:
Racemic talinolol (62.5 &ml) was dissolved in isotonic saline solution (pH, 7.6 to 8.0, 37” C) that contained 145 mmol/L sodium, 5 mmol/L potassium, 10 mmol/L bicarbonate, 140 mmol/L chloride and 3 gm/L polyethylene glycol 4000 (PEG) as a nonabsorbable marker.
This perfusate was infused continuously into the intestine through the perfusion port at 10 ml/min.
Each perfusion lasted for 160 minutes, resulting in an administered dose of 100 mg (Cordanum, Arzneimittelwerk Dresden GmbH, Dresden, Germany).
On the first study day subjects swallowed the tube after an overnight fast.
The middle of the test segment was positioned 95 to 115 cm beyond the teeth.
On the next day, 20 hours after beginning the first perfusion, a second identical procedure was carried out with the middle of the test segment located between 160 and 235 cm beyond the teeth.
It was important that the tube was positioned more distally on day 2 compared with its position on day 1.
